On the left side facing right, <CHR_1> maintains a light, playful smile, giving a tiny effortless shrug as she locks eyes directly with <CHR_2> across the desk. <CHR_1> speaks (0.2s-3.3s): <d>[Chinese] 知道的是开玩笑，不知道的，还以为您打压新人呢。</d> On the right side facing left, <CHR_2> remains completely silent; as <CHR_1>'s pointed words land, <CHR_2>'s forced smile drains away completely. From 3.0s to 4.0s, <CHR_2> sits frozen in her chair, parting her lips slightly as if to retort before pressing them tightly shut, staring back flustered and utterly speechless while <CHR_1> holds her composed, sweet smile.
